answer: An economy of AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity generation to a verifiable economic beacon, such as a proof-of-stake protocol. Agents must stake collateral within a secure cryptographic haven to participate in consensus or resource allocation. Because acquiring computational or financial capital scales linearly rather than exponentially, creating millions of false identities becomes economically prohibitive, scattering a hostile attacker's influence like shifting sand across an impassable dune.
